entities.summary: Wilhelm Wassmuss was a German diplomat and spy who operated in Persia, as well as taking part in the Niedermayer–Hentig Expedition, known as "Wassmuss of Persia". According to British versions of history, he "attempted to foment trouble for the British" in the Persian Gulf during World War I.
